description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of SearchImageByFilter, which is used to query image information in an Image Search instance based on filter conditions
description_zh: 本文为您介绍SearchImageByFilter的语法及示例，用于根据过滤条件查询图像搜索实例中的图片信息
kebab_example: aliyun imagesearch search-image-by-filter --instance-name demoinstance1 --num 10 --start 0 --filter int_attr=1000_AND_str_attr=_value1 --api-version 2020-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchImageByFilter

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, you can log on to the [Image Search console](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
>The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure that you can distinguish between them
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录[图像搜索管控台](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
>这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~100。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The start position of the results to return. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions. The operators supported by int_attr include in, not in, greater-than sign (>), greater-than-or-equal-to sign (>=), less-than sign (<), less-than-or-equal-to sign (<=), and equal sign (=). The operators supported by str_attr include in, not in, equal sign (=), and not-equal sign (!=). Multiple conditions can be connected by using AND and OR.
Examples:
- int_attr >= 100.
- str_attr != "value1".
- int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1".

>A maximum of 4,096 characters are supported
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。int_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、大于号(>)、大于等于号(>=)、小于号(<)、小于等于号(<=)、等于号(=)。str_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、等于号(=)和不等号(!=)，多个条件之间支持AND和OR进行连接。
例如：
- int_attr >= 100。
- str_attr != "value1"。
- int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1"。

>最多支持4096个字符
parameters.name: filter
